answers.core: Addons can't modify the behavior of built-in editor windows, and even if they could, Godot's UX is important, and improving it probably shouldn't be delegated to external tools.
answers.workaround: The workaround would be to simply be more careful, but this is less a workaround and more just ignoring the issue.
